name: Fami:Liar?
source:
Hayakawa Ayato has been living on his own since both of his parents passed away. While looking for jobs on day, 2 girls (sisters) claiming to be his father's bastard children, appear out of nowhere and begin stalking him... 

[from [url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE039993.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
父母双亡后，早川隼人一直独自生活。一天，他正在找工作，两名自称是他父亲私生女的姐妹突然不知从哪里冒了出来，还开始纠缠着他…

[摘自[url=http://eng.dlsite.com/work/=/product_id/RE039993.html]DLsite English[/url]]
